title: skills: objectstack-data still teaches field history as opt-in after the default flips
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC

Follow-up from #36290 (PR #36399, field old and new values shown on the record page by default). The PR's `Skills-docs: follow-up owed` line names this; L1 found no card. Filed by the seat. Parent: #36290.

## What happens

`skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` still teaches the opt-in model. Its `enable` table (around line 112) gives `trackHistory` default `false` as the field-level audit trail, and the object table row for `enable` (around line 104) lists `trackHistory` as a capability flag with no word on the new default. After #36399 an agent reading the skill would write metadata for a history model that no longer holds.

## To do

1. Rewrite the two rows to match the contract #36399 lands: field old and new values are shown by default, an object turns them off with `fieldHistory: false`, and a single field with `trackHistory: false`.
2. Say which readers see the values (members on fields they can read, through the activity stream; the full audit ledger stays admin only).
3. Check the skill's references for the same claim and fix them in the same change.

## Acceptance

- No sentence in `skills/objectstack-data/**` describes field history as opt-in.

Blocked-by: #36399

## Grade
p2 · domain:skills. Teaching drift, not broken; an agent following the skill writes needless or wrong history flags.
